script: My husband's hidden debts hit us—eviction papers slammed—now I am shocked.. Got eviction papers on Tuesday. I am like, "What the—?" My husband's been the one paying the lot rent for our trailer, but he's been skipping it for weeks. I handle daycare, phones, half the power, mortgage, internet. He's only got his car and lot rent. We kept separate accounts, never thought we needed a joint audit. Until this. We got a VP from the park on the line, and she's setting up a payment plan and putting the eviction on hold. Phew. But this isn't the first time money's been a nightmare. The first time we had our car repo'd. Now our home could be taken. Same pattern, same drama. I sat down with him alone (our daughter was at grandma's). I said, "I love you, but I love our daughter more. If you can't be financially responsible, you won't be. I will." I added, "You'll still see her, I am not taking that away, but I'll be the primary." I know it sounds like a breakup, but it was necessary. I am giving him one last shot, but I am also questioning if this marriage can survive. I am juggling everything, I am exhausted, I am setting up an account to monitor his money. Both of our checks go in, I am the boss of the budget. I don't want to weaponize it, but I feel stuck. I am at a loss, honestly. (I know, right?)
